description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the SubjectModifiedStrategy class, specifically testing its behavior when handling modifications to policy subjects with respect to labels. It uses the JUnit testing framework and AssertJ assertions to verify the correct application of policy effects.

classes.name: SubjectModifiedStrategyUpdateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of SubjectModifiedStrategy when a subject modification event occurs, focusing on label modifications in policies.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubjectModifiedStrategy, which is the class under test.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Creates and returns a SubjectModified event with specified timestamp and policy, simulating a subject modification event for testing.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions on the policy after the event has been applied to verify correct modification behavior.
